obfuscation_indicators: highly uncertain and cannot be predicted with confidence
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and supported by quantified occupancy, rent deferral, collection, liquidity, and portfolio concentration data. COVID-19, tenant credit, geographic and sector concentration, deferred rent collectability, and impairment assumptions remain material risks, although management presents liquidity and rent collections as currently adequate. Standard forward-looking disclaimers and reliance on management estimates somewhat limit visibility into downside outcomes.
